name: Digest gate-pressure: urgency fix + inline top-3 queue on WARNING
block: Phase 1 — gate urgency (22 days to Apr 7, 0/30 posts)
goal: Two changes to scripts/daily-digest.ts: (1) Fix getUrgencySignal(): current logic shows 'on track' when 0 posts recorded and 22 days left — this is false reassurance. Add special case: if postsRemaining > 0 AND gate.count === 0, return '⚠️ WARNING — 0 posts recorded. Start posting now.' regardless of days remaining. (2) When showKillReminder (urgency contains WARNING/KILL/FAILED): read top-3 unposted video IDs from ledger (exclude already-recorded), append them inline to digest as 'Post now → /record <id> 0' shortcuts. Operator gets actionable video IDs directly in morning digest without needing to run /queue.
rationale: 22 days with 0/30 posts shows 'IN PROGRESS — on track' which is dangerously misleading. The operator has never posted a single video. Fixing urgency + showing inline video IDs converts the morning digest from a passive report into a direct action prompt.
swarm: NOT USED — 1 file edit + 1 validation script. Direct write.
